title: neubrutalism_ui for Flutter
lede: A Flutter widget kit that carries the “neubrutalism” spelling into cross-platform mobile apps.
summary: Outlined, hard-shadowed Flutter buttons, cards, and search bars.

evidence.note: Downloaded and inspected the README demo image (1554 × 1224) hosted on user-images.githubusercontent.com. Package metadata read from the pub.dev API; licence read through the GitHub API.

styles.note: The package uses the name neubrutalism, and its demo app shows black-outlined widgets with solid offset shadows.

context: pub.dev describes it as “a set of Neubrutalism-style UI components”. Version 0.1.1 was published on 17 March 2023; version 2.0.2 on 10 November 2023. Publisher: infms.dev.
The repository carries a CC0 1.0 dedication.
observed: An iPhone mock-up of a course app. The search bar, icon buttons, cards, and “Start” button have thick black outlines.
Solid black shadows sit below and to the right of cards and buttons, with no blur.
Buttons use flat fills: saturated blue for the profile icon, pale pink for “Start” and the filter button.
Headings use a heavy condensed sans-serif. Corners are rounded more than on most web examples.
interpretation: Evidence that the style and the “neubrutalism” spelling moved into native mobile toolkits by early 2023. The larger radius shows a softer variant.
borrow: On mobile, keep the shadow offset small (about 3 to 4 px) so that dense lists stay readable.

rights.statement: The repository is dedicated to CC0, but the demo image is hosted outside the repository and includes third-party cartoon and photographic content, so it is not stored.
